description: For a finite index type \(I\) and a family \((A_i)_{i\in I}\) of finite subsets of a common set, the indexed union \(\bigcup_{i\in I}A_i\) is finite. This includes the empty index type.
signature:
Set.finite_iUnion.{u, w} {α : Type u} {ι : Sort w} [Finite ι] {f : ι → Set α} (H : ∀ (i : ι), (f i).Finite) :
  (⋃ i, f i).Finite
